a.lede: The social networking site is facing criticism for blocking access to the site, which identifies thousands of ICE agents and other employees working for Homeland Security.
a.title: Bluesky blocks links to leaked DHS employee data as government seeks takedowns

b.lede: Bluesky tells WIRED it blocked links to a leaked archive of information on 41,000 ICE, CBP, and other DHS workers because it contains people’s contact information, shared without their authorization.
b.title: Bluesky Is Blocking Links to a Major Leak of DHS Employee Records
